name: Sayonakidori wa Kaku Utau
original_name: サヨナキドリはかく歌う
source:
Sold off and turned into prostitute.

That's pretty much what happens to a orphan girl.

But the man said.

"You're free. Shackled, but you're still free.

You're restrained, but with hard work and talent, you can be anything you want to be, and you've got that freedom."

And it's my job to help,

It's my job as a trainer to help you.

...said the man.

[From the [url=https://sites.google.com/view/2t1t-game/%E3%83%9B%E3%83%BC%E3%83%A0/34naki?authuser=0]official website[/url]]
